tool_counting: Stop at observed threshold 80 native item/started commandExecution/webSearch/imageView/mcpToolCall/fileChange, or 900s; drain already queued raw events after stop and report any overrun separately. No hard token/dollar cap.
order_rule: fixed before model calls; sequential to avoid concurrent drawing/resource contention; no outcome-based reorder
treatment: B installs exactly the released SVG Skill; A has no target Skill. No forced skill invocation or extra workflow reminder in either prompt.
common_tools: same native shell/web/image tools, Python/Node, pinned read-only resvg-js2.6.2; no MCP/apps/remote plugins or image generation
isolation: external control-plane recorder; fresh Bubblewrap mount/PID namespace with clearenv and workspace/home/state/cache per actor; only verified B payload copied in, no installer cache. No host home/Windows mount/control-plane files/other arm/rubric/history; shared network/proxy/provider caches not controlled
delivery: output.svg + output.png and retained intermediate files/notes; no coordinator artwork edits

judges.access: only neutral PNGs and frozen rubric, in fresh isolated sessions; reverse order; no mapping/process/source

limits: One pair, nondeterministic generations, no statistical/general reliability claim; exact tool starts/wall/usage reported. Prior failures and all setup/run failures retained. No new Skill changes during this experiment.
